title: nf-core/mxampseq pipeline - params.targets_setup schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.targets_setup: a list of targets and their analysis settings

target.errorMessage: Target name is required, may only contain letters, digits and '-', and 'unknown' is reserved for reads matching no target

cutadapt_linked_adapters.errorMessage: Linked primers are required by cutadapt demux and must be like ACTG...GCRA with optional minimum overlap (e.g., ;min_overlap=3), non-internal (X) or anchored (^ and $) requirement at ends

consensus.errorMessage: Consensus is required and must be one of savont, vsearch

fastqfilter_params.errorMessage: fastqfilter_params may only contain letters, digits, spaces and . = _ - and must not set --fastq_filter, --fastaout, --threads or --fastq_qmax

clustering.errorMessage: Clustering must be one of cluster_fast, cluster_size, cluster_smallmem, cluster_unoise

clustering_params.errorMessage: clustering_params may only contain letters, digits, spaces and . = _ - and must not set --sizein, --sizeout, --consout, --threads, output flags or a cluster_* algorithm

savont_mode.errorMessage: Savont mode is required and must be one of pooled, independent

savont_params.errorMessage: savont_params may only contain letters, digits, spaces and . = _ - and must not set --threads
